text:
taylor: Deploybot blocked canary publish for image ecr://redwood/edge-service:canary-2026-06-10 — held for annotation parity check.

deploybot: [automated] publish-hold: manifest-list annotation mismatch detected across platforms. details:
```
inspect --platform=linux/amd64 -> annotations.provenance: present (len=1024)
inspect --platform=linux/arm64  -> annotations.provenance: missing/empty
```

omar: arm64 runner log shows a `cosign upload` timeout during attestation. job retried but the retried run did not complete attestation step.

taylor: did the retry create a new manifest list entry without annotations? that would explain the gap.

nina: yes, the retry path currently pushes a new image and then assembles manifest list; it looks like the arm entry got created before cosign finished.

release-coordinator: options: 1) pin serving to last-known-good digest and postpone canary; 2) attempt to re-attach attestation to the existing arm manifest (unsupported by cosign in our flow); 3) rebuild and push a fresh canary tag. which is lowest risk?

taylor: pin + postpone. we should avoid in-place fixes. pin to ecr://redwood/edge-service@sha256:c0ffee1234deadbeef5678aabbccddeeff00112233445566778899aabbccddeef from the 2026-06-09 canary. update release notes to indicate fallback.

omar: I agree. I'll open a quick change to the release manifest to point to the pinned digest. No manual retagging of the broken manifest.

deploybot: action logged: hold persists. recommended actions: [pin->ecr://redwood/edge-service@sha256:c0ffee1234deadbeef5678aabbccddeeff00112233445566778899aabbccddeef, schedule republish in 01:30 UTC change window, add release-note: "Canary deferred due to missing provenance on arm64; serving pinned to previous digest"].

nina: i'll harden the arm64 cosign step: increase uploader timeout, enable multipart upload for large attestations, and add a post-push manifest parity check that fails the pipeline if annotations differ.

taylor: and please add an automated check in the release pipeline to detect when a retry created an entry without waiting for attestations. that should prevent latent partial publishes.

release-coordinator: change window 01:30 UTC approved. I'll post PSA to #support and add a note to the public release draft. Also adding INF ticket for cosign uploader reliability.

omar: filed INF-2468 with logs and suggested fixes. attaching runner traces and cosign stderr.

nina: once arm build is rebuilt and attested, push as a new tag and request deploybot to re-run canary publish. no retagging of pinned digest and no in-place signature edits.

taylor: thanks. marking thread resolved once deploybot reports canary publish success or the pin is live in prod.

release-coordinator: will follow up in morning standup and close thread when canary passes. :white_check_mark:
